simple.meaning: דַּוָּי (davvây) is a Hebrew word meaning “sick ; figuratively, troubled.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: דַּוָּי (H1742) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 1:5, with occurrences in Isaiah, Jeremiah, Lamentations.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to דַּוָּי (H1742) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in דַּוָּי (H1742) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: דַּוָּי (davvây) / H1742 is traced through Isaiah 1:5, Jeremiah 8:18, Lamentations 1:22 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H1742. davvay [ דַּוַּי ] adjective faint (on form compare Ba NB 487 ) — דַּוָּי֑ Isa 1:5 2 t. — faint , always of heart 1:5 (|| לָחֳלִי figurative of condition of people); Jer 8:18 ; Lam 1:22 of sorrow and distress.
